_comment: Workbook exercise zone-reheat-saturated (docs/workbook/zone-reheat-saturated.md), lbnl-fpu part: the South-zone boxes (PFPU__<run>) with the rules that tell a zone short of heat from an overcooled one. reheat_capacity_shortfall (0.93, #44) uses its defaults: a sample counts when the zone is more than 1.5 F below its trended heating setpoint (RMHTGSPT_S) with the reheat demand at or above 90%, outside the first 2 h of each occupied period and after a setpoint step; warn from 5%, fault from 20% of evaluated samples and 10 h. The reheat signal is the controller's demand (RH_VLV_DM_S), which is why a valve stuck shut reads as saturated: the controller asks for full heat and gets none. overcooling_severity sets those same samples apart as a heating shortfall rather than overcooling; unmet_setpoint_hours counts the cold hours without asking whether the box had heat to spare; reheat_penalty is kept to show what it says about a valve that delivers no heat. Weekday 07-18 occupancy (the rules' default; the dataset has no occupancy point). Hourly resample: a year of 15-minute data.
